class.name: MaszynaMoverRailVehicleController
class.description: [RailVehicleController] simulated by the vendored Mover ([code]TMoverParameters[/code]): its configuration is written into the vehicle's Mover and its live values are read straight from it. Created by the FIZ import for a vehicle [MaszynaMoverVehicleServer] simulates; everything else reaches it through [RailVehicleController].

method.name: get_compartment_lights_intensity
method.description: How bright the compartment lights shine: 1.0 on the full supply, half on the battery alone, times their dimming; 0.0 while they are off.

members.member: [code]Cntrl.InactiveCabFlag[/code] Bitmask of automatic actions performed on cab deactivation/activation.
